subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should memory-core OpenAI-compatible embedding requests inherit `models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork`, including explicit `false` disabling exact-host private trust, as this PR implements?
rationale: The code path is mechanically sound, but accepting it changes a provider-level SSRF trust boundary and can intentionally change upgrade behavior for operators who set explicit `false`.

options.title: Accept Provider-Policy Inheritance
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix, with provider `request.allowPrivateNetwork` as the memory embedding trust source and the current omitted/false/true tests as guardrails.

options.title: Require A Different Trust Surface
options.body: Ask for a memory-specific policy or different compatibility rule before merge if maintainers do not want memory embeddings to share the provider request trust boundary.

options.title: Reject Private-Network Memory Opt-In
options.body: Close or supersede this direction if memory embeddings should keep the current fail-closed behavior and require external proxies instead.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider-Policy Inheritance
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix, with provider `request.allowPrivateNetwork` as the memory embedding trust source and the current omitted/false/true tests as guardrails.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre authored the adjacent provider SSRF trust-by-origin contract that this PR extends into memory embeddings.
